```{r, echo = FALSE}
#Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(rmarkdown)
library(lubridate)
library(readr)
library(zoo)
```

```{r}
#This is the definitive data
efteling_live_queue <- read_csv("../../data/final/efteling_live_queue.csv")
efteling_his_complete <- read_csv("../../data/final/efteling_his_complete.csv") #Includes feature engineering

#For the historical dataset WITHOUT the feature engineering variables, load this
efteling_his_merged <- read_csv("../../data/final/efteling_his_merged.csv")
```


# *Descriptive statistics*

## *Historical data*

```{r}
#Summarise definitive datasets
summary(efteling_live_queue)
```



```{r, echo = FALSE}
#Overview of weather conditions and crowd percentage aggregated to month level
efteling_his_complete %>%
  distinct(date, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(month = month(date, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE)) %>%
  group_by(month) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_crowd_percent = mean(crowd_percent, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_temp_actual = mean(temperature_actual, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_rain_actual = mean(rain_actual, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_wind_actual = mean(wind_actual, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  arrange(month)
```


```{r, echo = FALSE}
#Exploration of average queue time and crowd on a month level
efteling_his_complete %>%
  filter(!is.na(avg_queue_min)) %>%
  mutate(month = month(date, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE)) %>%
  group_by(month) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_crowd_percent = mean(crowd_percent, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_queue_time = mean(avg_queue_min, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  arrange(month)
```



  
## *Live data*


```{r}
#Summarise definitive datasets
summary(efteling_his_complete)
```


```{r}
#Of live data, calculate average queue time
efteling_live_queue %>%
```

# *Data Visualisations*

## *Historical data*

```{r, echo = FALSE}
#Graph for average historical queue time per attraction
efteling_his_complete %>%
  filter(!is.na(avg_queue_min)) %>%
  #Note; single-rider queues are not included
  filter(!grepl("Single-rider", ride)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = fct_reorder(ride, avg_queue_min, .fun = median, .desc = FALSE),
             y = avg_queue_min)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  coord_flip() +
  #Note; limit is set to 60 MINUTES for readability, 2 attractions have higher datapoints
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 60), breaks = seq(0, 60, by = 5)) +
  labs(x = "Ride", y = "Average Queue (min)")
```


```{r}
# 1. Prepare data directly from Rmd objects ----------------

# 1.1a Rides (attraction-level queues)
rides <- efteling_his_complete %>%
  mutate(date = as_date(date)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(avg_queue_min))

# 1.1b Park-level (crowd + weather)
park <- efteling_his_complete %>%
  mutate(date = as_date(date)) %>%
  select(
    date,
    crowd_percent,
    temperature_actual,
    rain_actual
  ) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(
    crowd_percent_num = as.numeric(crowd_percent),
    temp_actual_num   = as.numeric(temperature_actual),
    rain_actual_num   = as.numeric(rain_actual)
  )
```


```{r}
# 2. Historic overview of average queue times --------------

daily_queue <- rides %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_queue = mean(avg_queue_min, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

## 2.1 Figure 1a – raw daily series
p_daily_queue <- ggplot(daily_queue, aes(x = date, y = mean_queue)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "Daily Average Queue Time Over Time",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Average wait (minutes)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


## 2.2 Figure 1b – 7-day rolling mean
daily_queue_smooth <- daily_queue %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  mutate(
    mean_queue_7day = rollmean(mean_queue, k = 7, fill = NA, align = "right")
  )

p_daily_queue_smooth <- ggplot(daily_queue_smooth,
                               aes(x = date, y = mean_queue_7day)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "Smoothed Daily Average Queue Time (7-day Rolling Mean)",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Average wait (minutes)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```


```{r}

# 4. Weather & crowd aggregated at month level -------------

monthly_park <- park %>%
  mutate(month = floor_date(date, "month")) %>%
  group_by(month) %>%
  summarise(
    crowd = mean(crowd_percent_num, na.rm = TRUE),
    temp  = mean(temp_actual_num,   na.rm = TRUE),
    rain  = mean(rain_actual_num,   na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

p_monthly_crowd <- ggplot(monthly_park, aes(x = month, y = crowd)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "Average Monthly Crowd Percentage",
    x = "Month",
    y = "Crowd (%)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


# 4b. Monthly temperature
p_monthly_temp <- ggplot(monthly_park, aes(x = month, y = temp)) +
  geom_line(color = "tomato") +
  labs(
    title = "Average Monthly Temperature",
    x = "Month",
    y = "Temperature (°C)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


# 4c. Monthly rainfall
p_monthly_rain <- ggplot(monthly_park, aes(x = month, y = rain)) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue") +
  labs(
    title = "Average Monthly Rainfall",
    x = "Month",
    y = "Rain (mm)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```


```{r}
# 5. Monthly queue time vs crowd relationship --------------

monthly_rides <- daily_queue %>%
  mutate(month = floor_date(date, "month")) %>%
  group_by(month) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_queue = mean(mean_queue, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

monthly_joined <- monthly_rides %>%
  left_join(monthly_park, by = "month")

p_queue_vs_crowd <- ggplot(monthly_joined,
                           aes(x = crowd, y = mean_queue)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Monthly Relationship Between Crowd Level and Queue Time",
    x = "Crowd (%)",
    y = "Average queue time (minutes)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```


```{r}
# 6. Average queue time per ride ---------------------------

p_rides <- rides %>%
  group_by(ride) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_wait = mean(avg_queue_min, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(ride, mean_wait), y = mean_wait)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Average Queue Time by Ride",
    x = "Ride",
    y = "Average wait (minutes)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```


## *Live data*


```{r}
#Queue pattern identification for one particular ride
efteling_live_queue %>%
  filter(attraction_name == "Danse Macabre") %>%
  filter(queue_type == "STANDBY") %>%
  mutate(hour = hour(timestamp) + minute(timestamp)/60) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = hour, y = wait_time)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", span = 0.3, se = TRUE, color = "blue", fill = "lightblue") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 8:22, limits = c(8, 22)) +
  labs(
    title = "Queue Pattern for Danse Macabre Throughout the Day",
    x = "Hour of Day",
    y = "Wait Time (minutes)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```


```{r}
# 1.2 Live API data (15-min queues)
live_prepped <- efteling_live_queue %>%
  mutate(
    timestamp = ymd_hms(timestamp),
    wait_time = as.numeric(wait_time)
  ) %>%
  rename(ride = attraction_name)
```


```{r}
# 3. Queue pattern during the day (live data) --------------

hourly_queue <- live_prepped %>%
  mutate(hour = hour(timestamp)) %>%
  group_by(hour) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_queue = mean(wait_time, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

p_hourly_queue <- ggplot(hourly_queue, aes(x = hour, y = mean_queue)) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:23) +
  labs(
    title = "Average Queue Pattern Across Opening Hours",
    x = "Hour of day",
    y = "Average wait (minutes)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```
